chapter.title: The Forest Boar and the Little Witch

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sayuuu! You're sleeping again? Are you really that tired?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yeah... I moved those chairs, and I had to give Gena all those directions... It was hard work, so I rewarded myself with a nap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Jina"? Ohhh, like short for Mujina? Cute!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I knew it! I knew people were gonna think that. No, it's a name! A regular name! It's not short for anything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay. Not short for anything. Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, Gena's my imaginary friend by the way. She's invisible to people most of the time, so I never introduced you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon never really thought about it before, but... of course you all have imaginary friends! That's what kids do, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Shh! Don't call me a "kid," or you're gonna jinx my chances of getting taller! Soon, I'm gonna be a full-fledged ninja who can hold her own. I just know it.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: But before then, I guess it doesn't hurt to tackle things with a friend...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Besides, even if Gena helps me, it's not like most people would see. So, it would still look like I could hold my own.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know "holding your own" and "being alone" are two different things, right?

choices.text: Haha, guess it's open to interpretation.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Great! I have this ninjutsu device here that you can use to train with her!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I've been so busy with the other little witches, training has kind of taken a backseat...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're not telling us this so you can slack off while we do it for you, right?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: What? Um, no! It's not like that!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: This device is for escape training. Sensei left it for me, but as you know, I'm already really good at running away.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I don't need help with my own training assignments. I finished those ages ago.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: It's Gena... She's even lazier than me. If we're gonna make a break for it together, she has to be able to keep up. So she needs to finish her training.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: That's what I'm hoping to get some, um... help with.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... How is asking us to "help" not slacking off?

choices.text: I'm curious to see what Gena looks like.
